key_insight: The multi-domain AAA-least squares (nAAALS) method efficiently approximates harmonic functions across coupled interior and exterior domains with moving boundaries.
engineering_relevance: It offers a low-cost computational approach for coupled-boundary problems in inviscid fluid dynamics and other steady or quasi-steady applications.
method: Use AAA to approximate a function equal to the complex conjugate of position on each boundary, generating geometry-aware poles.
Solve a modified least-squares system enforcing coupled matching conditions across domain boundaries.
Couple nAAALS with standard Runge–Kutta schemes to evolve multiple boundaries.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports accurate reproduction of known vortex patch equilibria and evolution of new and existing non-equilibrium configurations, with runs taking seconds on a standard laptop.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative error benchmarks or scaling results, so performance for larger or more challenging domain configurations remains unclear.
paper_title: Multi-domain AAA-least squares methods and applications
